about.name: Razin Abdullah
about.heading: Razin designs the mistakes.
about.quote: People learn most at the moment they get something wrong, as long as it’s safe and they can see why.

facts.label: Worked on

process.heading: Live in 3 to 5 weeks.
process.intro: Five steps, one after the other. Your part is marked in orange, and it’s small.

steps.title: Find the moment
steps.desc: The one decision where your people go wrong.

steps.title: Sketch it
steps.desc: How the mistake will play out, before anything is built.
steps.you: a yes, or what to change

steps.title: Design the mistakes
steps.desc: Every wrong move plays out, with a reason.

steps.title: Build
steps.desc: Light HTML5, tested on the devices your people use.

steps.title: Play-test
steps.desc: Real learners try it. We tune until it feels fair.

pricing.heading: Three sizes. No “price on request”.
pricing.intro: You get a fixed quote before anything starts. Prices exclude VAT.

packages.name: Spark
packages.for: One focused piece. Test the water or fix one weak spot.
items: A video explainer (up to 90 s), an interactive activity, or a workshop activity
SCORM, MP4 or a web link

packages.name: Build
packages.for: A full simulation, built around your real mistakes.
items: One simulation or e-learning module, 15 to 20 minutes of practice
Play-tested with real learners, then tuned
SCORM or xAPI, set up in your LMS
Two rounds of revisions, source files included

packages.name: Programme
packages.for: When the training has to change behaviour.
items: Live discussion activities and a train-the-trainer session
Evaluation plan and a dashboard that shows learning gaps
Optional hosting, so you don’t need your own LMS

terms: Extra languages or a retainer? Just ask

faq.q: Will it run in our LMS?
faq.a: Almost certainly. SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004 or xAPI, tested in your LMS before handover. No LMS? We can host it.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: One expert for a kick-off call and two short reviews, the material you already have, and ideally a few learners for a play-test.
No. The simulations collect nothing unless you ask for tracking. With tracking, your LMS records completion and score.
You do. You get the source files and short notes on how to change text and images. It runs without us.
Videos, activities and most modules do. Detailed drag-and-drop simulations are built for laptops and tablets first. We tell you up front what fits.
Ask for it in your quote. Extra languages are priced in up front. The German kitchen game on the simulations page is one we built.

footer.why: Flight recorders are orange so they can be found after something goes wrong. Ours is for before.

sims.title: Fight or get out?
sims.hook: Water on a pan fire: fireball.
sims.play: Four fires. Grab something from the wall, or get out.
triad: Pan fire? Heat off, fire blanket.
sims.readout: Fire 3 of 4 · frying pan, staff kitchen
sims.alt: An office with a burning waste bin and extinguishers on the wall
sims.altMove: Fire 3 of 4: a frying pan on fire in the staff kitchen. The pointer is on the water extinguisher.
sims.altMistake: A kitchen engulfed by a fireball after water hit a burning frying pan

sims.title: Report or click?
sims.hook: One bad click and the network turns red.
sims.play: Eight emails, five fake. Point at a link before you click.
sims.alt: An email inbox next to a map of the office network
sims.altMistake: The office network map turning red, device by device

sims.title: Every dot is a person
sims.hook: Email the export home and 1,800 people leave the building.
sims.play: Six everyday calls. Watch where the people end up.
triad: Email customer data to private Gmail
Company data stays in company tools
sims.alt: A newsletter email beside a wall of 240 dots, one per person
sims.altMove: Situation 2 of 6: a customer export of 1,800 records. The pointer is on Email it to my personal Gmail.
sims.altMistake: 1,800 dots, each a customer, flying out of the company towards a personal Gmail account

sims.title: Changing a flat tire
sims.hook: Skip the brake and the car rolls off the jack.
sims.play: Four tools, one car. Try the wrong order first.
triad: The car rolls off the jack
sims.readout: Critical danger · car rolled off the jack
sims.alt: A red car with a flat rear tire beside a trunk of tools
sims.altMistake: The car rolling off the jack with a critical danger alert

sims.title: Cleanroom gowning
sims.play: Dress the technician, then walk into the clean zone.
sims.alt: A technician in street clothes beside a rack of cleanroom garments
sims.altMistake: Dust on the clean suit and the particle counter at 10,000

sims.title: Close the loop
sims.hook: Too slow and the material burns.
sims.play: Rescue waste from the belt before it reaches the fire.
triad: Too slow, or the wrong machine
Right machine: jeans become a tote bag
sims.alt: Waste on a conveyor belt heading for an incinerator
sims.altMistake: Torn jeans rescued and turned into a tote bag

sims.title: Eco-Party Planner
sims.play: Plan the school party. Keep the scale balanced.
triad: Check the claim before you buy
sims.alt: An empty school gym ready to be decorated, next to a balance scale
sims.altMistake: A trap warning: the compostable cups only compost in industrial facilities

sims.title: Wo ist der Löffel?
sims.play: Look around, open things, find the word.
triad: You hear its name, with article
Der blue. Die red. Das green.
sims.altMistake: The learner is asked to find die Blume in the kitchen
